checks.what: akkadian-empire loss to nobody at -2189 (Dudu's accession) of the Cliopatria -2200 shape outside the Akkad region and the 50 km Lagash disc. Page check: the Akkadian Empire page gives Dudu 2189-2168 BC; his kingdom was 'considerably reduced in size' and 'was likely limited to northern Babylonia around Akkad and Kish'; 'a few votive inscriptions and references to military campaigns are known, which were likely intended to preserve what remained of his kingdom'; it names 'Upper Mesopotamia with Tish-atal in Urkesh' among lands that 'declared their independence' during the decline. All the note's quotes are on the page. Region: the spec resolves to 925 cells (about 233,900 km2): Al-Anbar 165, Ninawa 148, Sala ad-Din 100, Dayr Az Zawr 94, Hasaka 83, At-Ta'mim 41, As-Sulaymaniyah 37, Arbil 32, plus the Sumer admin-1s (Maysan 57, Al-Muthannia 36, Al-Qadisiyyah 33, Dhi-Qar 30, Al-Basrah 15, An-Najaf 12) and edge cells. A loss only moves Akkad's own cells. Akkad drops from 947 to 216 cells at the end of -2189: Diyala 78, Wasit 65, Babil 26, Karbala' 14 and Baghdad 1 (the Akkad region, about 54,000 km2, which fits 'northern Babylonia'), plus Dhi-Qar 24 and Maysan 8 (the Lagash disc). The ledger keeps the Lagash disc until -2164, when second-dynasty-of-lagash/ledger/0 takes it (32 cells, unchanged). Side effects, checked in the window agent's stage: Akkad's own -2189 loss is paired with the Gutian gain. Because the patch region also covers Sumer, the patch frees Akkad's 170 Sumer cells first, and gutian-dynasty/ledger/1 then takes nobody's land, which is all of Sumer minus Lagash (170 + 326 cells). That equals the Gutian -2189 keyframe, so the 326-cell snap is gone. The keyframe's release of 5 Adab-disc cells in Wasit (194959, 194961, 194963, 194971, 195082, all in Adab 40 km and the Akkad region) now falls within tolerance. Those cells stay Gutian, as they have been since the -2220 founding at Adab, and go to Elam with the Akkad region at -2125 (elam/ledger/8, 189 cells instead of 184). This removes a 5-cell unowned hole at Adab, and the end anchor gains 5 Elam cells; nothing else changes. At -2154 the Akkad dissolve no longer releases 731 cells; the Gutian gain of the Akkad region (184) is unchanged. No dossier other than akkadian-empire is alive at -2189 for Upper Mesopotamia or the middle Euphrates (mari ends -2290, assyria starts -2025, ebla ends -2300), so 'nobody' is correct. Render of -2189 from the stage: Akkad is the Akkad core plus the Lagash disc, the Gutians hold Sumer, and Elam is unchanged. A tiny spur of the Diyala admin-1 at the northern tip is detached by a one-cell gap (cosmetic).

patch_check: events/0 akkadian-empire ok; 1 entries, 1 ok, 0 rejected (exit 0). The reviewer changed nothing, so the window agent's trial stage stands. In that stage the -2189 changes are: Akkad to nobody 731 (patch), Akkad to Gutians 170 and nobody to Gutians 326 (gutian-dynasty/ledger/1). The gutian-dynasty_-2189 snap is gone, and the only end-anchor change is 5 Wasit cells near Adab, now Elam's.
problems: Lagash exclave, a dossier matter that the patch inherits: the Lagash page says 'After the death of Shar-Kali-shari Puzur-Mama declared Lagash independent' and 'This independence appears to have been tenuous as Akkadian Empire ruler Dudu reports taking booty from there'. The Akkadian Empire page also lists 'the land of Sumer in Lagash' among the lands that declared independence. The ledger nevertheless keeps the 50 km Lagash disc Akkadian from -2189 to -2164, drawn as an exclave inside the Gutian Sumer, because second-dynasty-of-lagash starts at -2164 (Ur-Baba). The Lagash page dates the dynasty 'c. 2260 - c. 2023 BC'. A dossier fix could start second-dynasty-of-lagash (or a Lagash dossier) at Shar-kali-sharri's death, c. -2193 (the Akkadian Empire page: death 'around 2193 BC'), taking the Lagash disc from Akkad; the patch's Lagash exclusion would then be moot. The window agent's spec keeps the existing ledger, which is acceptable for a patch. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagash.

events/0 also covers the Sumer cells of the Cliopatria shape. This is harmless and useful: it frees Akkad's Sumer cells before the paired Gutian gain, so the gain takes the whole of Sumer minus Lagash and the Gutian keyframe snap disappears. The result therefore depends on the patch event running before gutian-dynasty/ledger/1 in the same year (the dossier order). If that order ever changes, the drawing reverts only to the pre-patch Gutian snap (326 cells, plus 5 Adab cells released), not to anything wrong.

The 5-cell end-anchor change (194959, 194961, 194963, 194971 and 195082 become Elam's at m2100) reaches the seam with m2100-m2001. The cells are in Wasit inside the Akkad region and follow Elam's -2125 Akkad holding.
